description: EA-08 / EA-36 (11e 09.07, 09.02.02, 09.07.01, 19.01). Setup privilege only: Boyz K (5 alive) and their attached Weirdboy are placed in two rows, engaged with two Witchseekers standing right in front of them (north). Everything after that is a REAL click / drag: (1) a click selects the Boyz — the movement panel shows the Desperate Escape box, unticked; (2) a click on Fall Back begins an Ordered Retreat; (3) a drag of one Boy straight north through a Witchseeker is REFUSED ('Ordered Retreat cannot move through enemy models' toast) and nothing is staged; (4) a click on the Desperate Escape box switches the mode (SET_FALL_BACK_MODE): SIX hazard rolls — 5 Boyz + the Weirdboy, the whole Attached unit — on the movement panel's dice log and the game log, casualties leave the board; (5) Ctrl+A and a drag move the whole unit north THROUGH the Witchseekers — staged; (6) End This Unit's Move: the unit ends unengaged and makes its 09.07 battle-shock roll.

steps.comment: setup privilege: 5 Boyz + attached Weirdboy, two Witchseekers in front

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(1640.0, 1200.0)
var z := 1.5
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
m.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: the refusal toast names the mode
the Game Log shows the desperate escape hazard rolls as a card with dice icons (the movement-phase dice surface there)
no way back to Ordered Retreat once the hazard rolls are made
the hazard casualties are gone from the board
every alive model of the Attached unit staged north of the Witchseekers
